kind: assumed inputs; nothing in this file is measured in the Demerzel repository
random_seed_note: The analysis draws no random numbers: every result is an exact count, a difference of counts, a ratio of counts, or a mean and a standard deviation of counts.

two_sigma_rule.note: Analysis choice, not an observation and not a project alarm. PSY-002 states a rule of this form for the rate of change of its crystallization index ('exceeding 2 standard deviations from its running mean'); it does not name the citation count as a signal. Here the rule is applied to the run-to-run step of the citation count summed over artifacts, to show what any rule of this kind sees. A step is flagged when |step - mean| > multiplier x standard deviation, with the mean and the population standard deviation taken over all earlier steps of the same series. A step with fewer earlier steps than minimum_history_steps is not tested. A step is per run, and the runs are unevenly spaced in time: the analysis therefore applies the same rule a second time to each step divided by the gap since the previous run, in days.

run_spacing.note: Descriptive thresholds, an analysis choice: the feeder is scheduled once a day, and a gap between two consecutive feeder runs is counted as short under short_gap_hours and as long over long_gap_hours.

rule_cases.note: Imaginary rows. Each gives the artifact's previous row (null when it has none; a previous row without a citation_source has source null) and the count and citation_source the feeder reads now. The analysis applies lines 90-99 of the pinned scripts/quality_trend.py to it. None of these rows exists in the repository.

cases.name: new_artifact
cases.description: First row of an artifact, measured by git grep.

cases.name: first_computed_value
cases.description: The previous row holds a hand-typed count and no citation_source; the new count comes from git grep.

cases.name: two_more_citing_files
cases.description: Both rows come from git grep.

cases.name: outside_the_repository
cases.description: An artifact that git grep cannot measure: no citation_source before or after.

cases.name: second_version_of_the_source
cases.description: A hypothetical later producer stamps a different source.

cases.name: source_tag_removed
cases.description: The evolution record loses its citation_source and keeps its count.

cases.name: citation_paths_edited
cases.description: Someone adds a second path to the record's citation_paths list; the producer and its source tag are unchanged.

transfer_task.note: Hypothetical defect log of a software team, for the learner task. Not Streeling data and not a forecast.
transfer_task.unit: open defect reports per component, logged once a week
transfer_task.log_rule: The weekly log applies the rule of the pinned feeder: rebaseline true and delta 0 when the row's source differs from the source of the component's previous row; otherwise delta = count minus the previous count (0 when the component has no previous row).
